name: GitHub
description: A collaborative software-development platform. Browse and search repositories, code, branches, commits, issues, pull requests, reviews, checks, workflow runs, releases, and tags. Sign in to view your repositories, work items, and notifications, and create pull requests with approval.

name.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

description.description: Repository summary, or null when none is set.

language.description: Primary programming language, or null when GitHub has not detected one.

stars.description: Number of stars on the repository.

starredByMe.description: Whether the signed-in user has starred the repository.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next result page, or null when there are no more results.

number.description: Issue or pull-request number within the repository.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

isPullRequest.description: Whether the result is a pull request rather than an issue.

createdAt.description: Creation time reported by GitHub, or null when unavailable.

items.description: Issues and pull requests in this result page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next result page, or null when there are no more results.

actions.label: Sign in to GitHub
actions.description: Opens GitHub sign-in.

actions.label: Check GitHub sign-in
actions.description: Checks whether you are signed in to GitHub.

signedIn.description: Whether the current GitHub page session is signed in.

actions.label: Get signed-in user
actions.description: Returns the signed-in user's login, avatar, and profile link.

actions.label: List my repositories
actions.description: Lists repositories owned by the signed-in user, ordered by recent updates.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: Search repositories
actions.description: Finds repositories that match names, topics, languages, activity, or other GitHub search criteria.

query.description: GitHub repository search query. Qualifiers such as language:swift and stars:>100 are supported.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: Search code
actions.description: Finds matching code and returns each repository, file path, link, and highlighted snippet. Some results require sign-in.

query.description: GitHub code search query. Use repo:owner/repository to restrict results to one repository.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: Get user profile
actions.description: Returns a user's public profile, follower count, and profile link.

username.description: Exact GitHub login to look up.

actions.label: Get repository
actions.description: Returns a repository's description, default branch, visibility, stars, forks, and link.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: List branches
actions.description: Lists repository branches page by page, including the default branch and each branch's latest author.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: List commits
actions.description: Lists recent commits on a branch, tag, or commit, including author, date, and link.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Omit to use the repository's default branch.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: List repository contents
actions.description: Lists files and directories at a repository path and revision.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

path.description: Directory path within the repository. Omit to list the repository root.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Omit to use the repository's default branch.

actions.label: Get file content
actions.description: Returns the raw text from one repository file at a branch, tag, or commit.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Omit to use the repository's default branch.

actions.label: List issues
actions.description: Lists open or closed issues in a repository, ordered by recent updates.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

state.description: Issue state to list. Defaults to open.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: List pull requests
actions.description: Lists open or closed pull requests in a repository, ordered by recent updates.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

state.description: Pull-request state to list. Defaults to open.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: Create pull request
actions.description: Creates a pull request from a head branch into a base branch. Sign-in and approval required.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner.

head.description: Branch containing the changes. For a fork, use owner:branch.

base.description: Branch to merge the changes into.

body.description: Pull-request body. When omitted, GitHub's repository template is preserved.

draft.description: Whether to create a draft pull request. Defaults to false.

maintainerCanModify.description: Whether maintainers may modify the head branch.

actions.label: Get issue
actions.description: Returns one issue's title, state, body, repository, and link.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: Get pull request
actions.description: Returns one pull request's title, state, body, repository, and link without its diff or comments.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: List pull request files
actions.description: Lists files changed by a pull request with status and line totals.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: List pull request commits
actions.description: Lists commits included in a pull request with author, date, and link.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: List pull request checks
actions.description: Lists workflow jobs and statuses attached to a pull request.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: List pull request review threads
actions.description: Lists inline review threads and comments on a pull request, including resolution state.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: List workflow runs
actions.description: Lists recent GitHub Actions workflow runs for a repository or one workflow.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

workflow.description: Workflow file name or workflow path. Omit to include every workflow.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: Get workflow run
actions.description: Returns workflow-run status, trigger, revision, duration, and jobs.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: Get workflow job
actions.description: Returns one workflow job's status, timing, and step conclusions without downloading logs.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: List notifications
actions.description: Lists the signed-in user's visible notifications with repository, link, and unread state.

cursor.description: Notification position returned by a previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: Search issues and PRs
actions.description: Finds issues and pull requests that match repository, state, author, label, text, or other GitHub search criteria.

query.description: GitHub issue search query. Qualifiers such as repo:owner/repository, is:pr, is:open, and label:bug are supported.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: My issues
actions.description: Lists open or closed issues assigned to, created by, or mentioning the signed-in user.

filter.description: Relationship to the signed-in user. Defaults to assigned.

state.description: Issue state to list. Defaults to open.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: My pull requests
actions.description: Lists open or closed pull requests created by, assigned to, awaiting review from, or otherwise involving the signed-in user.

filter.description: Relationship to the signed-in user. Defaults to created.

state.description: Pull-request state to list. Defaults to open.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: Get commit
actions.description: Returns one commit's message, author, date, parents, changed-file summary, and link.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: List issue/PR comments
actions.description: Lists top-level conversation comments on an issue or pull request in page order; review threads and timeline events are not included.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

number.description: Issue or pull-request number within the repository.

actions.label: List releases
actions.description: Lists the repository's visible releases with tag, display name, and link, newest first.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page; omit for the first page.

actions.label: List tags
actions.description: Lists the repository's visible tags with display name and release link, newest first.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

actions.label: Get README
actions.description: Returns the repository's README as raw text from a branch, tag, or commit.

repo.description: Full repository name in owner/repository form.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Omit to use the repository's default branch.

zh-Hans.name: GitHub
zh-Hans.description: 协作式软件开发平台。浏览和搜索仓库、代码、分支、提交、议题、拉取请求、审查、检查、工作流运行、发布版本和标签。登录后可查看自己拥有的仓库、相关议题和拉取请求以及通知，并在确认后创建拉取请求。

getSignInState.label: 检查 GitHub 登录状态
getSignInState.description: 检查你是否已登录 GitHub。

getCurrentUser.label: 获取已登录用户
getCurrentUser.description: 返回已登录用户的登录名、头像和个人资料链接。

listMyRepos.label: 我的仓库列表
listMyRepos.description: 列出已登录用户拥有的仓库，最近更新的排在前面。

searchRepos.label: 搜索仓库
searchRepos.description: 查找符合名称、主题、语言、活跃度或其他 GitHub 搜索条件的仓库。

searchCode.label: 搜索代码
searchCode.description: 查找匹配代码，并返回仓库、文件路径、链接和高亮片段。部分结果需要登录。

getUser.label: 获取用户资料
getUser.description: 返回用户的公开资料、关注者数量和个人资料链接。

getRepo.label: 获取仓库
getRepo.description: 返回仓库的描述、默认分支、可见性、星标数、复刻数和链接。

listBranches.label: 分支列表
listBranches.description: 分页列出仓库分支，包括默认分支和各分支的最近作者。

listCommits.label: 提交列表
listCommits.description: 列出分支、标签或某次提交上的近期提交，包括作者、日期和链接。

listRepoContents.label: 列出仓库内容
listRepoContents.description: 列出仓库指定路径和版本下的文件与目录。

getFileContent.label: 获取文件内容
getFileContent.description: 返回仓库中某个文件在指定分支、标签或提交上的原始文本。

listIssues.label: 议题列表
listIssues.description: 列出仓库中开启或关闭的议题，按最近更新时间排序。

listPullRequests.label: 拉取请求列表
listPullRequests.description: 列出仓库中开启或关闭的拉取请求，按最近更新时间排序。

createPullRequest.label: 创建拉取请求
createPullRequest.description: 从源分支向目标分支创建拉取请求。需要登录并在提交前确认。

getIssue.label: 获取议题
getIssue.description: 返回单个议题的标题、状态、正文、所属仓库和链接。

getPullRequest.label: 获取拉取请求
getPullRequest.description: 返回单个拉取请求的标题、状态、正文、所属仓库和链接，不含差异或评论。

listPullRequestFiles.label: 拉取请求文件列表
listPullRequestFiles.description: 列出拉取请求更改的文件、状态和行数统计。

listPullRequestCommits.label: 拉取请求提交列表
listPullRequestCommits.description: 列出拉取请求包含的提交，包括作者、日期和链接。

listPullRequestChecks.label: 拉取请求检查列表
listPullRequestChecks.description: 列出拉取请求关联的工作流任务及其状态。

listPullRequestReviewThreads.label: 拉取请求审查线程列表
listPullRequestReviewThreads.description: 列出拉取请求中的行内审查线程、评论和解决状态。

listWorkflowRuns.label: 工作流运行列表
listWorkflowRuns.description: 列出仓库或指定工作流最近的 GitHub Actions 运行记录。

getWorkflowRun.label: 获取工作流运行
getWorkflowRun.description: 返回工作流运行的状态、触发方式、版本、耗时和任务。

getWorkflowJob.label: 获取工作流任务
getWorkflowJob.description: 返回一个工作流任务的状态、时间和步骤结论，不下载日志。

listNotifications.label: 通知列表
listNotifications.description: 列出已登录用户可见的通知，包括所属仓库、链接和未读状态。

searchIssues.label: 搜索议题与 PR
searchIssues.description: 查找符合仓库、状态、作者、标签、文本或其他 GitHub 搜索条件的议题和拉取请求。

listMyIssues.label: 我的议题
listMyIssues.description: 列出指派给已登录用户、由其创建或提及其的开启或关闭议题。

listMyPullRequests.label: 我的拉取请求
listMyPullRequests.description: 列出由已登录用户创建、指派给其、等待其审查或以其他方式涉及其的开启或关闭拉取请求。

getCommit.label: 获取提交
getCommit.description: 返回单个提交的信息、作者、日期、父提交、更改文件摘要和链接。

listIssueComments.label: 议题/PR 评论列表
listIssueComments.description: 按页面顺序列出议题或拉取请求的顶层会话评论，不含审查线程和时间线事件。

listReleases.label: 发布列表
listReleases.description: 列出仓库中可见的发布版本，包括标签、显示名称和链接，最新在前。

listTags.label: 标签列表
listTags.description: 列出仓库中可见的标签，包括显示名称和发布链接，最新在前。

getReadme.label: 获取 README
getReadme.description: 返回仓库在指定分支、标签或提交上的 README 原始文本。
